(a) A reply names a thing as in the VOTE tab only after its card id is found in the registry, unvoted, and tagged red or shown first; the round record lists the ids; anything else is said as 'coming, NOT IN A TAB YET'. (b) A lane that writes IN VOTE writes the card id, and the card is in the registry in the same push ('my cards' with no id is a broken promise). (c) A lane that pulls a card says so on its row, and the coordinator stops naming it. (d) The gate is PLUMBER's [the card I name is on his screen]; EYES [does his screen show it] checks the deployed tab once a sweep.
119. A NEW SONG IS MADE WITH HIS SONGS' OWN MACHINE AND SOUNDS LIKE THEM (PAOLO 10/18, LOCKED, NO on The Long Road: 'both songs not giving analog horror vibes I was hoping the research that Grok helped you do would make it easier to do what you needed to do not like have a whole revamp process where you're like making songs I don't fit aesthetic'; records/BOHEMIA_PAOLO_BOTH_NEW_SONGS_ARE_NOT_ANALOG_HORROR_10_18_26.md). (a) A new song starts from his canon songs' own instruments, kits and arrangement (MLOOPS, synthV, drumV, SONG_ARR), read and reused, never edited; the pure chip style is dead as the sound of a song (two misses: Over the Ridge, The Long Road); a chip voice may sit inside a song only if it fits. (b) Research (Grok's PASSED music pages and every study) makes the song cleaner and quicker to make, never a new style. (c) Before VOTE the song plays beside two canon songs and EYES AND EARS writes one line: same game? analog horror? If no, it does not go to VOTE. (d) The card plays the new song next to the canon song it came from.
120. GUNS FIRST, THE FIGHT SAYS WHAT IS WEAK, THE ONE YOU CONTROL WEARS THE AURA, AND THE FACE IS THE BODY'S FACE (PAOLO 10/18, LOCKED: 'the combat is still so fucking ass... the game doesn't explain to you at all that your weapon sucks... I wanna start off with the guns too... the guns were supposed to be the main way this is gonna be solved... when you're controlling a person there should be some aura, fifth dimension, electric Amalgamation vibes, analog horror... around that character even on the big map, not just a portrait... the portraits don't even look alike, Black people looking like white people'; records/BOHEMIA_PAOLO_THE_COMBAT_IS_STILL_ASS_GUNS_FIRST_THE_AURA_AND_THE_FACE_IS_THE_BODYS_10_18_26.md). (a) GUNS FIRST: every origin's first fight has guns in the company's hands, and the gun is the main way a fight is won (rule 83 stands: guns two tiles and more, melee one); the starting kit, the first band and the tutorial fight are built around shooting. (b) THE FIGHT SAYS WHAT IS WEAK: before a shot or a swing, under the finger, the hit chance and what it does to that target's armour, and one plain line when the weapon is bad for it ('your pipe barely dents his plate'); after it, what it did. Battle Brothers hides this in a tooltip; we show it (rule 80). (c) THE AURA: the man you control wears a fifth-dimensional, electric, analog horror aura in the fight and on the big map's party marker, on the beat, drawn in the rig's look (rule 115); never a coloured outline (his NO on the blue and orange lines stands); the Amalgamation's ambiguity stays locked. 144. THE AUTO BUTTON WEARS THE ODDS, AND YOU CAN RETREAT (PAOLO 10/24, LOCKED: 'how good is the auto combat system, and how good is it at detecting the percentage of victory... this is a good direction to have that option... maybe the auto button can be green, or turns a very tiny opacity greenish, or red when the auto chance of victory is not... also, can you retreat in this game?'). (a) The odds stay his favourite read (141(a)): the fight plays the rest out on AUTO 24 times from the board as it stands and counts the wins; today the number shows only at 80 percent or better. (b) The AUTO button always wears the odds once they are read: a faint green tint when the fight is likely won, a faint red when it is likely lost, the number under the word, never loud. (c) RETREAT, Battle Brothers' way (records/target/bb/rules.json: men on the edge retreat safely, the others move to the edge with a zone-of-control defence bonus): a RETREAT button in the fight; who reaches the board's edge escapes, who is caught fights on; you leave with no pay; a retreat is never a wipe. (d) COMBAT; no card. (e) AMENDED THE SAME HOUR (PAOLO 10/24: 'there's a difference between winning with one character left standing at one HP and winning without taking a single casualty... I wouldn't press AUTO unless I'm guaranteed none of my members would die... maybe we don't show the percentages, a number in the background the player never sees, they only see the colour... an opacity, varying levels of the colour on a scale, not five colours: green green green, red red'): THE ODDS COUNT CASUALTIES and THE NUMBER IS HIDDEN. What the colour measures is the chance of a CLEAN WIN (won with none of yours down or dead), each run also weighing how many of yours fell; the player sees ONLY the colour: one continuous scale (never steps) from the deepest red (a loss, or men lost) through nothing to the deepest green (a near-certain clean win), as the button's tint by opacity; no percentage on the screen. Amends (b) and 141(a)'s 'letting me know your percentage': the colour is that read now. (f) ADDED THE SAME HOUR (PAOLO 10/24: 'if any members die during your mathematical projections, then that's leaning towards red'): A DEATH PULLS RED. A run in which any of his men dies counts toward red even if the fight was won; a run won with a man down but alive sits between; only runs won with nobody down push green. (g) ADDED THE SAME HOUR (PAOLO 10/24: 'I don't want clear; if it's clear, could go either way, that means it's gonna be risky'): NO CLEAR MIDDLE. The scale has no neutral: it is green only where a clean win is likely, and everything from 'could go either way' down is red, deepening as the risk grows; the turn from green to red sits high (a fight that is merely even reads red).

A HIT SHOWS, AND THE GROUND REMEMBERS (PAOLO 10/24, LOCKED: 'when an enemy gets hurt, or even your own player, I want them to turn slightly faint red opacity, and then I wanna see blood come out, maybe blood splatters too... what happens in Battle Brothers during combat, the live effects that get left on the ground... if an enemy gets down he might fall on the ground, a pile of blood underneath him... we need a little bit more of that'; records/BOHEMIA_PAOLO_A_HIT_SHOWS_AND_THE_GROUND_REMEMBERS_10_24_26.md). (c) Machines and ghosts bleed their own way (oil and sparks; static and the purple aura, rule 136), never red blood. (d) Made the 3D way, inside analog horror (grime and film, never cartoon); COMBAT builds it; Grok's ask 33 checks Battle Brothers' exact effects; no card.

(b) THE FOG OF WAR, Battle Brothers' way: at the start the map is hidden except a radius around you; it clears as you travel and stays cleared; the street sight of 151(g) rules what moves inside it. (c) A NEW-GAME OPTION, 'reveal all settlements': the settlements show through the fog from the start, everything else stays hidden; off by default unless he says. (d) The settlements outside the square map are part of it: they show at the map's edge in the direction they lie, through the fog when revealed. (e) RUN builds it, WORLD's generator behind it.

(b) AFTER EVERY WON FIGHT, Battle Brothers' way: a quick summary (each man's experience gained, who leveled up, who is hurt, who fell), then the LOOT: what the enemy dropped (their guns, armour, ammo, batteries, scrap), a LOOT ALL button that takes as much as the stash holds and stops when full, and taking piece by piece. (c) THE STASH: a company inventory with a size you can see (the bag screen), where loot lands, gear is equipped from on the one crew screen (147), and the shop buys and sells from. (d) A level-up does something you choose (Battle Brothers' perks, the library's tree). (e) RUN TWO builds the screens; COMBAT posts what the fight produced; no card.

WHAT YOUR CREW CAN'T SEE READS DARK (PAOLO 10/24, LOCKED: 'during combat I see you trying to implement a vision system; some enemies behind the line don't get shown; if you want a vision system in combat you have to do a lot better: if there are tiles that our team, with their vision all together, can't see, you've gotta be able to tell; a different opacity, maybe a grey darkness to it... it's gotta be done a lot better'). (a) The fight's vision is shared by the whole crew: every tile none of your men can see is shaded a grey darkness by opacity, analog horror (a soft static, never flat black), and lifts the moment someone can see it. (b) An enemy on a hidden tile is not drawn; one seen and then lost leaves a faint last-seen mark. (c) Sight follows Battle Brothers' rules (the library: sight range by trait and headgear, night shorter, height helps, walls and buildings block), on the house tiles. (d) COMBAT, near the top of its board; no card.

EVERY ACTION IS A REQUEST ON THE MUSIC'S BEAT, AND MORE MUSIC (PAOLO 10/24, LOCKED: 'a big thing is we need more music... one of the most important things I said months and months ago: the combat turns are taken as requests: every time you press a button it's a request, and the game does those actions on the BPM, everything is supposed to be on the BPM clock of the music, and we totally lost sight of that in this revamp... some of the songs are background hums without drums, but we made this universal BPM music thing for a whole reason, to give that extra layer of love; if I press AUTO or I'm fighting turn by turn manually, it's a request to be on the same BPM with any action'; records/BOHEMIA_PAOLO_EVERY_ACTION_ON_THE_MUSICS_BEAT_AND_MORE_MUSIC_10_24_26.md). (a) THE 120 BPM LAW, restored: every tap in the fight is a REQUEST; the action lands on the MUSIC'S own beat (the shell's song clock, the universal 120 BPM), by hand and on AUTO alike. (b) Measured: the rebuilt fight waits for a quarter-beat of its OWN clock (slices/BOHEMIA_FIGHT.html onBeat(), beatMs()), not the song's, and the speed, the hand and the turn's pace divide it, so the actions drift off the music. The fight reads the song's clock; a faster speed lands on finer divisions of the same grid (half and quarter beats), never off it. (c) Every song keeps the universal beat even when it has no drums (the clock runs under a hum). (d) MORE MUSIC: SOUNDS makes more songs in his songs' own machine (119) and in the vibe of his OVERWORLD NIGHT category and REPO MAN THE MACHINE PARTY; a new song still waits in the VOTE tab until he says it joins (122(d), the one card kind kept).
159. IT IS AN ECONOMIC APOCALYPSE: NO RAINBOW (PAOLO 10/24, LOCKED: 'I said I don't want the world drowned in grey yellow desert sand, but now I'm seeing you make buildings look rainbow coloured, adding grass and greens... do you have any idea what an economic apocalypse means? Maybe on the Strip, maybe, but some of the houses are turquoise blue... we're not one right now; maybe in act three things get better, part of that transformation over time; but it's an economic apocalypse, it just happened; there shouldn't be so much colour'; records/BOHEMIA_PAOLO_NO_RAINBOW_IT_IS_AN_ECONOMIC_APOCALYPSE_10_24_26.md). AMENDS 137(b), whose list of colours (green lawns, blue pools, painted houses) was the COORDINATOR'S, not his, and caused it. (a) Act one is a city ten years after the money died: colour is FADED, DIRTY and RARE: sun-bleached and peeled paint gone toward grey, dead brown lawns and dust, grey and stained concrete, rust, char, tarp, plywood, oil; variety comes from material, value, wear and light, NOT from hue. (b) No grey-yellow sand flood AND no rainbow: the old 'a third' measure stays for sand, and saturation stays low (his 9/23 vote stands: 'the bright colours not so bright, vibrance turned down'). (c) Colour as an ACCENT only: the Strip's neon (maybe, he said), the factions' own colours where they claim ground (COLOUR IS TERRITORY), a faded sign, a single painted door; never whole houses in turquoise, never green grass in act one. (d) Colour comes back over the acts (act three things get better, rule 128): the same scenes re-rendered with more colour as the world heals. (e) COOK regrades the map's 69 district pictures and anything else that went bright, now, first.

(b) RESEARCH FIRST, not built now: how it plays across three acts, lore-friendly costs that sound right for rebuilding a dead city (batteries, the six resources, labour, years), a PURPOSE for every building (what it does for the company, the people and the economy), and how each looks in each act (the palette of 159: act one faded, colour returning as it heals). ECONOMY researches (lifted when it runs; Grok ask 39). (c) records/BOHEMIA_THE_WHOLE_GAME.md carries it as its own section so no lane loses sight of it.
162. THE KILLER COMPANY: STATS AND LEVEL-UPS (PAOLO 10/24, LOCKED: 'in Battle Brothers, to create the most killer group, almost unstoppable: equipment is one thing, but stat-wise you'd have three people with guns in the back line whose priority was ranged attack, melee attack and fatigue and health, and the nine others whose priority was fatigue, melee attack and melee defence... now since we have more ranged, to form the best team you have to care a lot more about ranged defence... in Battle Brothers you had to really prioritise when you levelled, min-max a killer group who barely get hit and whose hits always land, with enough fatigue for everything plus the heavy armour... an endgame team will need more points in ranged defence too, so we might have to give more points per level... and the rolls that gave a better amount to resolve, whether they flee or not, morale, mattered'; records/BOHEMIA_PAOLO_THE_KILLER_COMPANY_STATS_AND_LEVEL_UPS_10_24_26.md). (a) LEVEL-UPS ARE BATTLE BROTHERS': on each level you raise a few attributes from a rolled range (the man's talent stars widen the roll), choosing which; the min-max a veteran player loves stays. (b) RANGED DEFENCE MATTERS MORE than in Battle Brothers because guns lead (rule 120): an endgame company needs it on top of melee skill, melee defence, ranged skill, fatigue, hitpoints and resolve, so the points per level may rise (TUNING sets it: three picks or more) so a killer company can be built. (c) The shape he knows works, as the floor the numbers are tested against: a back line of three shooters (ranged skill, fatigue, hitpoints) and a front of nine (fatigue, melee skill, melee defence), now with ranged defence across all twelve. (d) Resolve (morale) rolls matter. (e) TUNING sets the numbers (research only); RUN TWO builds the level-up choice; COMBAT's fight uses them; no card.
163. THE FIRST VERSION OF THIS INSTRUMENT REPORTED TWO FAILURES AGAINST THE BIBLE WITH EVERY CONTROL GREEN, AND BOTH WERE FALSE. *** It said 220 full-frame overlays and 2 runtime composite passes. Most of the 220 were 44x44 draws onto 44x44 SPRITE SCRATCH CANVASES -- a draw that covers a scratch canvas is not an overlay on anything. THE BEST CUT (EYES E27, rule 18d, 9/20; record records/BOHEMIA_EYES_E27_THERE_IS_NO_BETTER_CUT_9_20_26.md, raw runs records/BOHEMIA_EYES_E27_BEST_CUT_RUNS_9_20_26.jsonl)
 *** THERE IS NO BETTER CUT TO GO BACK TO, AND THE RANKING WILL NOT HOLD STILL. *** Eight RUN build stamps across two weeks, each cut by the repo's own cutter in a throwaway worktree at that sha (nothing of RUN's touched), each walked the same 90 seconds on a phone-shaped CPU with the throttle proved real in every run. TWO FULL PASSES.
   EVERY CUT IS FROZEN FOR 95.0% TO 96.6% OF ITS FIRST NINETY SECONDS. Best to worst across the whole fortnight is 1,385 ms out of 90,000, one and a half percent. AND THE ORDER REORDERS ITSELF: pass one's least-frozen was 9/15s, pass two's was 9/18g, the NEWEST. The gap between best and worst is smaller than the noise on a single cut, so the order is a coin toss, and when a ranking reorders on unchanged code the honest report is not a winner -- it is that the things being ranked are the same.
   WALKING IS BROKEN ON ALL EIGHT: a four-second held press moves 0.1% to 2.7% of the screen, dial found and pressed every time, that control green on every cut.
   AND I AM NOT NAMING A COMMIT FOR THE ONE THING THAT LOOKED LIKE A REGRESSION. Worst single freeze sat at ~33 s for the first four cuts and ~41 s for the last four, breaking between 9/15s and 9/16f. Bisecting the 55 commits there is NOT MONOTONIC (32.7, then 40.3 thirteen in, then 33.2, then 32.6, then 41.9). So I ran ONE SHA FOUR TIMES: 41,873 / 32,113 / 32,728 / 33,040 -- one run in four lands in the high mode on identical code. Then pass two proved it the other way: 9/15m went 33,019 -> 41,364 and 9/16f went 41,873 -> 33,370, two cuts swapping sides. That mode does not live in the code, and I was one step from handing RUN a commit to revert.
   SO FOR RULE 18(d): THERE IS NOTHING TO REVERT TO. Reverting buys one percent of a frozen window and throws away everything built since. The freeze is not a regression that crept in; it has been the same size the whole fortnight. If a reference is still wanted, take the NEWEST, because nothing measurably better exists behind it.
   WHAT THIS DOES NOT MEASURE, STATED: it scores loading, freezing and whether a held press moves the world. It does NOT judge pictures, so if 'closer to being able to play' was about the car, the streets or the far zoom, this says nothing about that. 90 seconds is weighted to the boot, where the freezing is; over 300 seconds the frozen share is about a third, not 96%.

 3. SCHOOL: how real accessibility crawlers avoid exactly this. MobiGUITAR and ACE discover states by DRIVING from the start screen and stop when every event leads somewhere already visited -- never from a written list. Android's own Monkey tool gets 10.3% activity coverage because it presses blind to what state it is in; a fixed card list is the same mistake from the other side, pressing without knowing the game's state has moved. Round two builds the driven crawl instead of the list, reusing thumb_gate.js's addEventListener wrap and city_rail_gate.js's read-what-the-column-holds pattern rather than rebuilding either.

THE SHAPE, DECIDED: the sixty-boss ladder is the MAIN LINE (53 of 60 wired, one verb each, nothing procedural touches it), and everything else is ASKED FOR BY THE SYSTEMS, never written: a person you know, in a place with an owner, wants something they cannot get because of a debt, a bill, a border, an empty shelf or a family that owes. No ask introduces a verb the game does not already do; if it needs a new verb it is a boss, not a quest.
THE ONE RULE THAT MAKES IT WORK: AN ASK THAT CHANGES NOTHING VISIBLE IS NOT AN ASK. The research says generated quests read as filler for exactly one reason -- finishing one changes nothing the player can see -- so every ask must move something visible in a system that already exists (a block changes hands, a debt clears or is called in, a shelf refills, a person moves house, a light comes back on, what people say about you changes). An ask that cannot name what it visibly changes is not offered. Gate that first.
STATE (the lane's own, written 9/6 by the chat holding it): THE GENERATOR EXISTS AND IT RUNS IN THE GAME. engine/bohemia_asks.js turns a running system into somebody asking, and gates/asks_visible_gate.js is 38/0 with the real surface driven. THE FINDING FOR ANY LANE COPYING A MECHANIC OUT OF A GAME HE NAMED: take the SHAPE and leave the numbers, and say in the file which is which. STATE ADDED 9/13 by [company in asks]: *** YOU HAVE PEOPLE NOW, AND NOBODY KEEPS A LIST OF THEM. A bond earned by finishing a job makes that person yours, by name, and deleting the bond un-makes it in the same instant. THE FINDING FOR ANY LANE ASKED FOR A ROSTER, A PARTY, A CREW OR A COMPANY: do not build the list. A list is a thing somebody has to maintain and the moment it exists it can disagree with the world. Compute membership from the records the world already keeps, every call, and the disagreement becomes impossible rather than unlikely. THREE LEDGERS ALREADY RECORD A PERSON AND THE PLAYER TOGETHER -- a bond (quest runtime), a witness (deed ledger), a roof (century household stamp) -- and the third one is a COUNT PER ACT that can never name anybody. That limit is enforced in code so a number can never become a face. AND THE TRAP THE LIVE DRIVE FOUND, WHICH ANY SEAM READING A CAST WILL HIT: ctDayCast() goes null the moment a quest is done, and the bond is earned AT the ending -- so at the exact instant somebody becomes yours, the only thing that can turn their role into a person disappears. Read the recorded cast, not the function. ITS LIMIT, STATED: that record is keyed on quest and day, so a bond from an earlier day loses its cast when a new one is rung. Naming somebody for good needs a record that outlives a day and that is a row somebody has to build. ***

- OPEN  [day one]  A-DAY-YOU-COULD-DESCRIBE -- one full in-game day in the demo, from waking to the bed, that a player could describe to somebody else afterwards without using a single one of our words. Walk it, write what happens, and name the parts that are still nothing.
- OPEN  [five minutes]  A-UNIT-OF-PLAY-THAT-FITS-A-BUS-RIDE -- harvested from DYNASTY's hundred-hour round (records/BOHEMIA_HARVEST_TWO_A_HUNDRED_HOURS_IN_FIVE_MINUTE_BITES_9_6_26.md). The measured reality: a mobile session is 5 to 6 minutes, four times a day, and 96% of players are gone by day seven. We are building a hundred-hour game for that person. Not an argument against the hundred hours -- it is the point -- but it decides the SHAPE: build a unit of play that fits five minutes and is worth something finished (a job done, a debt paid, a block walked, one fight), with a real stopping point at the end of it rather than a thing abandoned half-done. The save is already hard; this is about the shape of the play, not the save.
- OPEN  [a shift]  A-SHIFT-IS-THE-FIVE-MINUTE-UNIT -- with WORLD [a days work] and RUN [five minutes]: a shift is the piece of play that fits a bus ride. It starts, it ends, and there is a battery at the end of it. Somebody is expecting you at a place at a time; you go, you do it, you get paid, you can put the phone down. That is the smallest complete thing this game can offer, and it does not exist.
- OPEN  [a day is]  THE-DAY-IS-A-DIAL-AND-FIFTEEN-MINUTES-IS-THE-DEFAULT -- the craft's answer is that a full day in about fifteen real minutes makes a day feel like a decision (the best farm-life game does this and copied a brisker ancestor on purpose), while real-time days let a player leave without fear. We need both: a day short enough to decide, a session that never punishes leaving. Put day length on a dial in DEMO SETTINGS, default fifteen real minutes, so a shift (RUN [a shift]) is a third of a day. Needs PLUMBER [clock math] for the current number.

- NOTE 10/24 FROM SOUNDS  [the bullet lands]  For your change 6 (a win is a moment, the count-up): its sound is in the game (BUILD 10/24a). At the moment the battery number starts to climb, post window.postMessage({ type: 'BOHEMIA_COUNT_UP', from: 240, to: 270 }, '*') (or call BULLET.countUp(from, to) in the shell; it returns the same plan). It ticks a real electromechanical counter once a 16th on the song's own grid (24 ticks at most, 3 s) and drops the battery into a steel crate with a bell on the beat after the last tick; counting down (a lost fight) ticks softer and drops dull, no bell. Move the number with the ticks: the reply BOHEMIA_COUNT_UP_PLAN { plan: { ticks, startMs, stepMs, landMs } } (performance.now() times; also window.__countUpPlan) says when each tick sounds: one step of the number a tick, the last number at landMs. Nothing pops up: the sound is the moment, the number moves where it lives.

WHY: the board pays 30 / 60 / 90 by the skull and nothing else, while the map sizes the band by the company and the burn grows by every man (9 a day for three, 22 for six, 41 for twelve, 50 for fourteen); a won one-skull job buys the twelve 0.43 of a day. A child is not personally liable for a parent's unsecured debts; creditors claim against the ESTATE and an insolvent estate means the creditor loses. The exceptions prove it (co-signing was always your own debt; community property reaches a SPOUSE; filial responsibility laws exist in about two dozen US states and are rarely enforced). That is an ADVANTAGE, and it is the leg up an heir must arrive with, at no stat cost. THE HEIR IS NOT A NEW CHARACTER, THE HEIR IS THE SAME HANDS IN A ROOM THAT HAS ALREADY DECIDED SOMETHING ABOUT THEM. AND THE DIVERGENCE IS ALREADY RUNNING IN OUR ARITHMETIC: gossip() carries `inherited` and `of` so WHOSE deed it was survives every retelling, and forceOf applies GEN_LOSS 0.45 per generation, so the father fades on a fixed curve while the heir's own deeds enter at full weight and overtake him inside one life. NOTHING SHOWS IT HAPPENING. AND THE LAST STEP THROWS THE ATTRIBUTION AWAY: opinionOf returns a BARE NUMBER, dropping `of` and `inherited` after they survived the witness, the gossip and the fold. One field at one call site turns a number into a sentence. THE DELIVERABLE (what must CHANGE, not what carries) is section 6: who is in the room, what they assume, that it is about him, the weight shift, who vouches, the refusable trade, the taken seat -- and NOT the verbs and NOT the hands. MEASURED 9/5 by Q13 [child watches]: THE ROW'S PREMISE IS SLIGHTLY WRONG IN A USEFUL WAY. The learning research says WATCHING is the smaller half: people pick up a trade through LEGITIMATE PERIPHERAL PARTICIPATION, being allowed real but peripheral work inside a working community, and the authors are explicit that this is 'MORE THAN AN OBSERVATIONAL LOOKOUT POST'. The load-bearing word is LEGITIMATE. THE CHILD DOES NOT INHERIT WHAT THEY SAW, THEY INHERIT PERMISSION TO BE THERE. So the inheritance is a DOOR, not a stat -- and the games side agrees loudly (players call stat boosts between generations inelegant and a grind, and prefer unlocked options), which is day 9 horizontal and day 10 access-not-power reached independently for a third time. AND THE DOOR IS ALREADY BUILT: engine/bohemia_asking.js has SEVEN subjects (names, power, salvage, strangers, the hill, water, work), FOUR trades (keeper, scav, watch, worker), every subject answerable by TWO DIFFERENT TRADES, one refusal per trade, and it is referenced from the walked city. KNOWLEDGE IS ALREADY GATED BY WHICH TRADE WILL TALK TO YOU AND NOTHING CONNECTS THAT DOOR TO A PARENT. THE FINDING: our machine converts what you DID into what people SAY about you, and never into what your child is ALLOWED TO LEARN. THE HEIR INHERITS A REPUTATION AND NOT AN APPRENTICESHIP. The row's exact ask (what the heir starts with because of what the player DID, not what they owned) answers in one sentence: THE TRADES YOUR PARENT WORKED WITH ARE THE TRADES THAT WILL ANSWER YOU. NOT ANSWERED AND FLAGGED RATHER THAN PADDED: the row also asks 'at what age', and I found no defensible age figure and did not invent one. MEASURED 9/5 by Q14 [three arcs]: THERE ARE THREE GENERATIONS AND ONLY ONE VERB CHANGE, AND IT LANDS AT THE FIRST FOLD, NOT THE DRAMATIC ONE. The two folds are not the same kind of fold: at fold 1 the player has ~5 hours invested (round 1 measured eight animal verbs as a five-hour game) so losing it is CHEAP and is the strongest teaching device the game has; at fold 2 the player has ~90 hours and round 10 proved a new rule set makes a beginner of a master. THE FIRST FOLD CHANGES THE VERBS, THE SECOND MUST NOT. MEASURED IN THE DECODED FIGHT: our human verb list is EXACTLY NINE -- hit, move2, cover, kill, shot, open, quiet, dark, close -- each attached to a KIT ability with a need cost (PLATE UP, BREAK CONTACT, STEADY, SLIP, CALL IT, READ THE ROOM, PATCH IT, LIGHT IT, SEND HIM). SIDE BY SIDE, SEVEN OF THE ANIMAL'S EIGHT MAP ONTO A HUMAN VERB WE ALREADY BUILT, and the two gaps are the whole answer: the animal has SMELL and the human has nothing like it, and the human has OPEN and COVER which need hands and made things. THE FIRST FOLD IS A STRAIGHT TRADE: YOU LOSE THE NOSE AND YOU GAIN HANDS. Everything else survives it renamed, so it is teachable in ten minutes. AND GEN 1 IS NOT A SEPARATE GAME, IT IS OUR GAME WITH THE NOSE ON AND THE HANDS OFF, which is far smaller than 'design gen 1'. The real aisle points the same way: humans uniquely throw at high speed via elastic energy stored in the shoulder, the fastest motion the body makes, so the human signature is ACTING AT A DISTANCE WITH AN OBJECT (`shot`), the mirror of the animal knowing what happened here before it arrived. THE ANIMAL KNOWS THE PAST. THE HUMAN REACHES THE DISTANCE. THE ANGEL SEES THE WHOLE THING AND CAN TOUCH NONE OF IT. MEASURED 9/5 by Q15 [angel means]: OUR GAME CAN RECORD AND IT CANNOT RESOLVE. Searched engine/bohemia_standing.js, engine/bohemia_deeds.js and engine/bohemia_engine.js for forgive, forgiven, settle, settled, absolve, pardon, spare, redeem: ZERO HITS. The deeds module's whole function list is about getting a deed INTO the world (publish, publishStage, sayWhy, reachOf, hopsFor, cloutWeight, neutralWeight, scanQuest, loadCorpus) and there is no function that resolves one, so a deed is written, travels, fades and is never settled. THAT IS THE SAME HOLE FOUR ROUNDS OF THIS LANE FOUND FROM FOUR SIDES: Q4's write-only `wounds` (declared once, pushed once, never read), Q8's three-string monument, Q11's death that leaves a mark nobody can clear. AND WE ALREADY BUILT THE RECORDING ANGELS WITHOUT CALLING THEM THAT: the tradition gives every person TWO angels who write the good and the bad, and our engine gives every person TWO ledgers, `recordedKnown` (which the Amalgamation can model exactly) and `blindSpot` (which it can never see). Nothing anywhere compares the two for a person. THE ROW ASKED FOR VERBS AND ROUNDS 10 AND 16 SAID THERE ARE NONE, AND BOTH SURVIVE: the nine built verbs are things you do TO THE WORLD, and an intercessor's verbs are things you do ABOUT WHAT SOMEBODY ELSE DID, which is a different layer and not a tenth combat move, so the rules the player spent ninety hours learning are untouched. THE SIX: CARRY, WITNESS, WEIGH, SETTLE, SPARE, STAND BETWEEN -- five of which act on data we already write and never touch again. THE FIRST TWO GENERATIONS WRITE THE LEDGER. THE THIRD IS THE ONLY ONE THAT CAN CLOSE A LINE IN IT. Refused on purpose: any undo (SETTLE closes a line, it never erases a deed, because a deed that never happened breaks the witness web and Q11's rule that a scar is a repair and not a deletion), any right answer (the traditions themselves split on whether a guardian intercedes at all, so watching and intervening are separable and the choice is the mechanic), and a third refusal of an act-3 combat change. STATED HONESTLY: the cost argument (to stand between two things you have to stop being one of them) is MY reasoning from the role, not a citation -- I searched for what the role costs the one doing it and found nothing usable. Scope: engine searched, slices not swept. MEASURED 9/5 by Q16 [hundred hours]: WE ARE BUILDING THE HOUR AND THE GAME IS MADE OF RETURNS. 100 hours is 6,000 minutes; the mobile median session is 5 to 6 minutes (top quarter 8 to 9, about 4 sessions a day), so a hundred hours is between 1,000 returns at the median and 200 at a generous half-hour session. THAT IS THE MOST REPEATED MOMENT IN THE WHOLE GAME AND WE HAVE BUILT IT ZERO TIMES: swept every slice for a returning-player surface (welcome back, when you left, while you were gone, what you were doing) and got ZERO. AND THE RECAP IS ALREADY WRITTEN: 27 quests are baked into the alpha carrying 164 rows of kind:'journal', first person, past tense, one per stage, and THE ONLY CODE IN THE REPO THAT READS kind==='journal' IS THE DIRECTOR TOOL PAOLO TYPES THEM IN. The save protects the STATE perfectly and nothing anywhere protects the INTENT; a save that survives is not a player who returns. AND THE MIDDLE IS OUR THINNEST ACT, MEASURED THREE WAYS: boss ladder act1/act2/act3 = 20/12/7, laws numerals = 145/57/86, laws+records spelled out = 111/29/49. Act 2 loses every count, and the craft says the middle is exactly where long games die (three-act structure does not scale past 8 hours; the named failure is movement without progress). ALSO NOTHING KNOWS HOW LONG YOU HAVE PLAYED: zero hits for playtime, hoursPlayed, totalTime, minutesPlayed (control: 89 'hour' hits in the engine, all golden hour and wake times), so we claim a hundred hours and own no instrument that could ever tell us the middle sagged. COMPLETION IS THE COST OF LENGTH: about 14% finish primary content across games (one in seven), RPGs run ten points below that, a 61-hour campaign was finished by 15 to 17% while 16-hour games of other genres sit near 50%, so on the published curve MOST PEOPLE WHO START BOHEMIA NEVER MEET THE ANGEL and gen 3 is the least-seen content in the game. SAY THE GOOD PART TWICE: bohemia_save.js is the best-engineered thing this lane has measured (two slots with a generation counter so the newest good save is never the write target, FNV-1a checksum plus byte length verified on load, tombstones so a stale save can never resurrect, a probe sized to the real save, driven by a gate against a hostile fake browser), and RUN already shipped the home screen answer to WebKit's seven-day storage wipe, which is the hardest constraint a hundred-hour phone game has. AND THE MIDDLE HORIZON IS BUILT AND CAPPED: the mandate ladder is inlined on the walked surface behind a real STANDING button reading live standings, three rungs for three acts, and MAYOR_SHARE is STILL null at slices/BOHEMIA_CITY_WORLD.html:11031 (verified live this round, not quoted from the 8/28 law), so it tops out at two rungs of three while the evidence says proximal week-sized goals are the only goal distance with a demonstrated effect and distal goals have none. A PENDING SINCE 6/30 IS SITTING ON THE ONLY MOTIVATION STRUCTURE THE RESEARCH SUPPORTS. AND THE MIDDLE SAG IS THE SAME BUG AS ROUND 9 AND ROUND 17: a middle cannot escalate in a world with no subtraction (no -= and no Math.min in the fold) and cannot conclude in a game where no deed can be settled. Also the spine is short: the live ladder is v7 with 53 candidates against the 60-boss pillar and its own header calls it a pool to cut from. Reference law obeyed: BATTLE BROTHERS only (this row IS the campaign layer), and the completion research's game titles were STRIPPED so no unnamed reference enters through the back door. Scope: engine AND slices both swept this round. ALSO: nothing replaces or ages out the population at a generation boundary (control: 'cohort' appears once in the engine and it is the comment REFUSING a birth-year generator), so 100% of the cast survives our fold against a measured real figure near 3% after ten years. THE FINDING: a time skip in games is an art job, in life it is a CAST CHANGE -- the room stays and the people go -- and round 4 already showed our districts can only get NICER, so we cannot do the art half and should not want to. AND TEN YEARS COLD CLAUSE 1 ALREADY RULES THE CUT: do not play the ten years, the same way the crash is never played.
CORRECTED 9/7 (Paolo): Animal / Human / Angel are the three ERAS (the anarchy decade, the world clawing back, the cyberpunk healing), never creatures. Rounds 1 and 2 researched a literal animal on a misreading; they stay as records, their coyote findings route to wildlife, and "what you can do with no hands" is void for the player. The lane's subject is unchanged otherwise: the fold, the heir, ageing, what carries.

WHAT WAS STILL REAL, MEASURED DIRECTLY IN THE CODE: wouldSquare() is one sum with no exception -- `out.would = out.rest > 0 && (out.rest + out.grudge) >= 0` -- so a stolen loaf and a killing are the same KIND of number, only a bigger one; real reconciliation research and every legal system treat some harms as a different kind, never just a bigger number. AND FORGIVING IS NOT TRUSTING AGAIN in the literature (two separable outcomes) but the code has one bit, d.right, for both. Apology's real order (Lazare): acknowledgment, explanation, remorse, reparation, a testable promise -- the code has acknowledgment (the button) and reparation (priceOf); explanation, remorse and a testable promise have no representation. RESEARCH: habits take a median 66 days and one missed day barely matters (Lally 2009), so a streak that punishes a miss contradicts its own headline finding; habits are carried by a stable cue, not a reward (Wood and Neal 2007); paid-for returns decay when the pay stops (Lepper 1973, Ryan, Rigby and Przybylski 2006); a specific plan releases an unfinished goal (Masicampo and Baumeister 2011); a cue left at the moment of leaving shortens the way back in (Altmann and Trafton 2002); recap depth should scale with the gap (Cepeda 2006); the end decides how coming back feels (peak-end). THE MORNING: one line, his own last @LOG line, on the phone that already rings; after a night one line, after about a week that line plus who he last spoke to and where the marker stands; never a number of days, a list, a streak, a gift or a timer. The library has no save, resume or time-away content (checked all ten volumes; Battle Brothers ambitions are the nearest cue), and no other game is named (Q16 rule kept). ROUTED: RUN/UI (one field written by the flush that already runs, one selector, the phone that already rings); TUNING (gap thresholds are felt numbers); WORDS and QUESTS (do the 249 lines stand alone when read cold); PLUMBER [bb library]. Deliver what our morning should be.

THE ONE GAP: flat fill share has no existing number; round two adds it as the direct complement of edge density (pixels below a low gradient floor), the same shape as dark_line's own threshold-and-share pattern. SOURCED AGAINST PRIMARY LITERATURE: edge density is a real standardized CV term (Canny 1986, IEEE PAMI; OpenCV's own tutorial); contrast range maps to Michelson/RMS contrast (Peli 1990, JOSA A, the paper establishing RMS contrast for complex images); flat fill share maps to GLCM Homogeneity (Haralick, Shanmugam and Dinstein 1973, IEEE SMC, the founding co-occurrence-matrix paper); distinct colours and outline share have no single coining paper (named honestly, not forced) but tie to real literature (colour quantization/Heckbert 1982; cel-shading ink-line separation, Decaudin 1996 INRIA). THE SELF-REPORT GAP NAMED: DIRECTION already printed its own stats() numbers straight into two VOTE cards (the ground twin, the places twin) -- exactly what this row exists to independently re-check, not trust. THE CROPS REUSE EXACTLY: the tool builds real PIL Image objects from real source files (not guessed boxes); round two imports it directly so the pixels measured are provably the same ones a reader sees in VOTE. VERT- (the wrong way): a wider screen gets its vertical view cropped to make room, so a narrower screen can see MORE of the world than a wider one -- backwards. HOR+ (the real, converged industry answer): the VERTICAL slice stays fixed across every aspect ratio, only the HORIZONTAL extent grows or shrinks. So round two's real test is not "is each percentage big," it is WHETHER COMBAT's own 77/67/87/83 percent claims follow a Hor+-shaped pattern (portrait and landscape sharing a vertical slice, width doing the adapting) rather than an arbitrary spread. A REAL RUBRIC, NOT AN INVENTED ONE: the Widescreen Gaming Forum (WSGF) is the actual body the industry uses to grade aspect-ratio support, Gold/Silver/Limited/Unsupported, on whether the HUD stays legible and placed sensibly, nothing stretches, and nothing gameplay-critical gets cropped off the glass -- round two grades each class this way, not just a raw percentage.
